rows.before: Manufacturing Credits: How Gondaliya CPA Supports You

Book a free consultation with Gondaliya CPA. Bring your last two filed returns, a list of equipment purchased with available-for-use dates, and a short description of any production problem you solved by testing. Those three establish which credits are open, which years are still inside the 18-month window, and what the claim is worth. You'll get a flat fee before any work begins.

Machinery bought, a process problem solved by trial, or a year-end approaching its 18-month limit?

For a flat annual fee stated before the work starts, we screen your projects against the uncertainty test, cost them by project with the proxy or traditional method, and prepare the T661 and Schedule 31 alongside Schedule 572 for the Ontario credit. We classify each asset so the machinery lands in Class 43 and the building in Class 1 at the manufacturing rate, apply the assistance grind correctly so nothing is reassessed later, coordinate the Ontario and BC credits where you operate in both, and represent you if CRA reviews the claim.
